scope: Selected source-level inspection, source path inventory, and documented/native test declarations; no upstream code executed; no compatibility status promotion.

evidence_definitions.source_inspected: Selected implementation/entry points inspected; some listed paths only inventoried, as noted in findings.
evidence_definitions.not_established: Equivalent mechanism not established; not evidence of absence.

entries.findings: ROM family, language and revision selection; symbol/task and save-block decoding; cache aging/reset; frame controller.
entries.recommendation: Retain actor and exact hash admission; isolate profile/reader selection behind #139, then prove one second title with private native tests. Never inherit offsets or language patches without evidence.

entries.findings: Frame-driven generators/listeners and task-specific waits; no equivalent revisioned objective contract established.
entries.recommendation: Use event boundaries as behavioral reference only. Preserve single input writer, bounded waits (frames AND wall time), fresh legality, verified postconditions and explicit objective intent.

entries.findings: Bot policies select scripted actions; this audit did not establish an equivalent general LLM/external-choice protocol.
entries.recommendation: Retain Pokegent's typed frame API. Use deterministic mechanics only after a legal choice; evaluate routing and model modes separately under R03/R09.

entries.findings: Encounter/fishing observations, deduplication, phase summaries and persisted statistics.
entries.recommendation: Add typed, public-safe outcome facts to existing events/ledger when necessary. No parallel database or raw Pokémon records; distinguish observation from verified outcome and reset/replay duplicates.

entries.findings: Directional/elevation-aware local pathfinding, live object occupancy, destination warp handling, timeout and replan.
entries.recommendation: Keep world graph and static-artifact design; record exact source/entry/landing and failed edge with current evidence, bound retries/cycles, regenerate path after interruptions; prove offered route edge consistency. Do not claim a Seafoam fix without capture.

entries.findings: Fly badge, move, visited destination and region checks; cursor RAM and task completion; field-move gates differ by game.
entries.recommendation: Distinguish legal capability from route usefulness and objective policy. Diagnose missing proof; verify the live Fly cursor against pinned pret source/local ROM before widening launch coverage.

entries.findings: Rod selection/registration, task-phase reactions, encounter/got-away/no-bite outcomes.
entries.recommendation: Add one bounded rod/target action through FieldBuilder + executor, independently verify task semantics; legitimate failed attempt is a typed game outcome, not an infrastructure failure.

entries.findings: Raw and effective wild encounters with repel/lead ability effects; encounter-triggering move; RSE Feebas tile model.
entries.recommendation: Separate static table, current availability and conditional effective distribution. Core supports normal encounters, not necessarily hidden-state shortcuts. Validate title-specific mechanics before exposing claims.

entries.findings: Background event classification, facing requirements, NPC interaction and pickup-related hooks.
entries.recommendation: Keep hidden item facts out of default agent-visible state until discovered under player-knowledge policy; distinguish visible pickup from normal hidden-item search. Full hidden-item action not established.

entries.findings: Waypoint actions for water, bike, special terrain and selected puzzle scripts; native test declarations.
entries.recommendation: Generalize movement semantics through game adapters rather than route scripts. Audit ice specifically against the target ROM; no proof that the reference resolves every ice puzzle.

entries.findings: Singles/doubles state and explicit targets, escape/catch/damage estimates and Safari-specific actions.
entries.recommendation: Preserve existing calculators and exact-action choice. Compare behavioral cases against pret/Showdown/damage-calc in R06; validate independent formula cases, target legality, battle format and uncertainty. Do not adopt deterministic battle policy as mandatory AI strategy.

entries.findings: Individual identity, checksum, nature/gender, EV/IV, friendship, shiny status; derived traits.
entries.recommendation: Add version-aware, validated derived facts at a legal observation boundary; verify known vectors, egg visibility, unknown/checksum failures, and privacy/redaction. Hunting decisions remain separate.

entries.findings: Stable identity selection, box/party/item workflows, registration, release checks.
entries.recommendation: Audit capability gaps without weakening irreversible-action intent. Verify actual identity/slot and quantity changes, safe cancellation and no last healthy release/deposit. No automatic release policy.

entries.findings: Allow/stop evolution, replace/decline learning, nickname policy hook. Tests explicitly inspect evolution/move results.
entries.recommendation: Use test sequences including resume, final acknowledgement and wrong-menu control. Nickname hook is not proof of arbitrary name-entry support. Preserve explicit irreversible intent.

entries.findings: Target EV and encounter yield checks, level grinding and resource thresholds, battle rotation heuristics.
entries.recommendation: Core planning facts for levels, EV targets, matchup, resources and tradeoffs; no mandatory grind loop. Validate EV cap, gain modifiers and exact RAM postconditions. Team optimization is broader than one battle strategy.

entries.findings: Compatibility, parent data, egg-ready and hatching sequence; title-specific variants.
entries.recommendation: Split inspect daycare, compatibility, deposit/withdraw parent, collect egg and hatch event. FireRed unlock and capacity must be proven; no default release of non-target offspring.

entries.findings: Dex reading and storage exist; complete trade protocol or interactive dex UI not established by inspected sources.
entries.recommendation: Ordinary core scope. Research game-specific NPC trade and link capability separately; do not infer support from readers.

entries.findings: Dex state and multiple acquisition mechanics, but no general dependency-complete dex planner established.
entries.recommendation: Replace land-only 1–151 fallback limitations incrementally with per-game acquisition graph; distinguish catch, gift, evolve, breed, trade, version exclusives, event and unverified/unsupported routes.

entries.findings: Menu-driven buying/selling, quantities and healing trips.
entries.recommendation: Compare pre/post quantity, money and HP; preserve protected items and current shop stock. Reuse existing shop code and incident tests, not a new bot policy.

entries.findings: Berry growth/interaction and blending modules exist; details not audited here.
entries.recommendation: Ordinary mechanics; title-specific state and clock evidence first, optional farming policy later.

entries.findings: Reset-to-title and starter scenarios; native test suite starts from states.
entries.recommendation: Test fresh boot and intro independently; no claim of an autonomous cold-to-credits run from these focused scenarios.

entries.findings: Specialized scenarios and puzzle solutions, not a verified general campaign framework in inspected evidence.
entries.recommendation: Retain existing story/objective source and verified milestones; independent repeated RAM-backed campaigns required.

entries.findings: Selected legendary/puzzle/roamer/Safari and other title-specific scenario surfaces; Game Corner and berry blender are inventory-level references only.
entries.recommendation: Normal side-content actions are core; add game-dependent capability IDs and explicit admission/verification, do not ship hardcoded routes or claim complete postgame.

entries.findings: Encounter criteria, repeat hunting, reset modes, RNG sequence/test helpers.
entries.recommendation: Optional hunting policy selects legal core actions and protects target, budget, saves and abort behavior. RNG manipulation separately opt-in; test-only RNG writes or debug writes never enter normal executor.

entries.findings: Lifecycle and observation hooks; OBS/Discord/web surfaces identified (transport implementations not audited).
entries.recommendation: Design a read-only observer API and separately admitted policy extension API; no direct emulator input, untrusted plugin execution or public exposure of local/private data.

entries.findings: No complete challenge-rule, speedrun or model-training framework established by this audit.
entries.recommendation: Future R09/R11 work; retain ordinary mechanics in core and specialized policy/experimentation optional.
